BOSS OZAN

Shardfall

Knock your rival off the floating arena. Higher damage sends them flying farther. Three stocks, no health bars. Crates, barrels, cars and walls can be smashed - burn, freeze or blow them up.

Match setup

Mode

VS

Ranked: a random opponent near your rank on a random stage, 3 stocks. Every consecutive win earns a bigger streak bonus (+3 RP more each win, up to +30). Quitting or closing the game mid-match counts as a loss. Tap your rank above to open the ladder.

Boss Ozan: a giant Ozan on a huge arena. Drain his health bar to win. He gets angrier at 2/3 and 1/3 health. Quake waves: jump over them. Eruptions: move away from the red glow. Meteors: watch the warning markers. You keep your stocks; the boss only has the one big health bar. CPU level sets how smart he is.
